visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a white ceramic bowl filled with steamed stinky tofu. The tofu pieces are submerged in a reddish-brown savory broth and topped with a pile of shredded green onions, a meat patty, and edamame beans. A white spoon rests on the left side of the bowl. The lighting is warm and highlights the steam rising from the dish. (2) The scene shifts to a pair of wooden chopsticks picking up a single square of golden-brown fried stinky tofu. The tofu has a crispy, porous texture and is drizzled with a dark brown sauce and a small garnish of cilantro. In the background, a small portion of white pickled cabbage is visible on a white plate. (3) A hand is seen holding a pink and white paper order menu with Chinese text. The background is a restaurant interior with wooden tables and chairs. (4) The camera shows the exterior of the restaurant, which is situated in a quiet, narrow alley. The entrance features dark wooden doors and a matching wooden bench, set against a stone-paved courtyard with rectangular decorative elements. (5) Several close-up shots follow, showing a white spoon lifting pieces of soft, white steamed tofu from the broth and another shot of fried tofu rolls being dipped into a small dish of red chili sauce. The food looks glossy and steaming hot. (6) The camera pans across the empty dining area of the restaurant, showcasing several clean, wooden tables and chairs. A large circular wall decoration with black Chinese calligraphy is prominent in the background, and a traditional-style lantern provides soft, warm lighting. (7) The final shot shows a narrow city street with parked motorcycles and modern high-rise apartments in the background, while a text overlay provides the restaurant's address.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional food review aimed at introducing a local stinky tofu restaurant in Kaohsiung. By showcasing the different styles of tofu (steamed and fried) with high-quality close-ups and enthusiastic narration, the creator intends to highlight the unique taste and comfortable environment to attract food lovers to visit the shop.
